quantra_Period.description:
Canonical period type used across APIs. Both fields are presence-required:
a bare `n` would silently default to 0 and an omitted `unit` would silently
mean Months, so a forgotten value is a 400 naming the field rather than a
silent (0 Months) tenor.

quantra_FlowInterest.description: Interest cash flow with fixing and accrual metadata.

quantra_FlowsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single flow in a collection.

quantra_SabrCalibrationDiagnostics.description:
Calibration-specific diagnostics. Populated only for SABR surfaces whose
kind is SabrCalibrate. For SabrParams surfaces (and other kinds in future
extensions) this sub-block is absent on the parent SwaptionVolDiagnostics.

per_node_rmse.description: Root-mean-square fit error per (expiry, tenor) node, row-major nExp*nTen.

per_node_max_abs_error.description: Worst single-strike absolute error per (expiry, tenor) node, row-major nExp*nTen.

overall_rmse.description: Aggregate RMSE across the entire cube.

converged.description:
True iff every node converged to a stationary point (i.e., end criteria
is not None and not MaxIterations on any node).

iterations_per_node.description:
Iteration count per node. Sentinel -1 indicates "not exposed by the
optimizer" — current QuantLib (1.41) does not expose this publicly from
the SABR interpolator, so v1 always emits -1. Field is retained for
schema forward-compatibility.

strikes.description:
Strike spreads used in calibration (rate units, e.g. -0.02 = -200bp).
Same vector applied at every (expiry, tenor) node.

per_strike_fit_error.description:
Per-strike fit error (fitted - market) for each (expiry, tenor, strike).
Row-major nExp*nTen*nStrikes.

quantra_SwaptionVolDiagnostics.description:
Diagnostics block describing one swaption vol surface. Emitted opt-in by
/sample-vol-surfaces and /price-swaption when include_diagnostics=true, and
reused as the response body for the standalone /calibrate-swaption-vol
endpoint.

kind.description: Resolved swaption vol kind for the surface.

expiries.description: Per-node grid axes, mirroring the surface's pillars.

forward_per_node.description:
Per-node forwards F(expiry, tenor), populated when handle is built.
Row-major nExp*nTen.

atm_vol_per_node.description: Per-node ATM vols sigma(F) evaluated via Hagan. Row-major nExp*nTen.

time_to_expiry_per_node.description: Time-to-expiry in years for each node. Row-major nExp*nTen.

alpha_per_node.description:
SABR parameters in effect at each node. For SabrParams these are the
user-supplied values; for SabrCalibrate these are calibrator output.
Row-major nExp*nTen, schema field order alpha, beta, rho, nu.

calibration.description:
Calibration sub-block. Present only for SabrCalibrate; absent for
SabrParams (and other kinds in future extensions).

warnings.description: Validation warnings. Empty when fit is healthy.

quantra_SwaptionResponse.description: Swaption pricing response with NPV, Greeks, and diagnostics.

npv.description: Present value of the swaption under the selected model and market inputs.

implied_volatility.description:
Implied volatility reported by the engine. For non-constant vol setups this may be a best-effort value.
Absent when the engine provides none.

atm_forward.description:
ATM forward swap rate used for pricing diagnostics. Present only with
swaption_pricing_details.

annuity.description:
Underlying swap annuity (PV01-style quantity). Present only with
swaption_pricing_details.

delta.description:
Analytic forward delta (swaption_pricing_details): change in NPV for a 1bp
move of the forward swap rate, annuity held fixed (Black/Bachelier
deltaForward x annuity x 1e-4). Currency per bp. Absent unless
swaption_pricing_details is set (the rebump path does not compute it).

vega.description:
Vega: change in NPV for a 1bp (1e-4) move of the quoted volatility
(lognormal vol for Black, normal vol for Bachelier). Currency per bp of vol.
swaption_pricing_details: analytic (calculator vega x annuity x 1e-4).
swaption_pricing_rebump: central difference of a +/-1bp vol bump.
When both flags are set the rebump value is reported. Absent when neither
flag is set.

gamma.description:
Gamma per bp^2. swaption_pricing_details: analytic d2NPV/dF2 of the forward
swap rate x 1e-8, annuity held fixed. swaption_pricing_rebump: second
difference of a +/-1bp parallel curve bump (npvUp - 2 npv + npvDown).
When both flags are set the rebump value is reported. Absent when neither
flag is set.

theta.description:
Theta in currency per calendar day. swaption_pricing_details: pure time
decay of the option premium with forward, volatility and annuity held fixed
(-1/2 sigma^2 F^2 Gamma for Black, -1/2 sigma_N^2 Gamma for Bachelier,
per year, divided by 365). swaption_pricing_rebump: NPV(as_of + 1 calendar
day) - NPV(as_of) from a full market roll. When both flags are set the
rebump value is reported. Absent when neither flag is set.

dv01.description:
DV01 in currency per bp. swaption_pricing_details: equals `delta` (forward
rate moved 1bp, annuity held fixed). swaption_pricing_rebump: central
difference of a +/-1bp parallel bump of the discounting and forwarding
curves (forward and annuity both move). When both flags are set the rebump
value is reported. Absent when neither flag is set.

used_volatility.description: Volatility actually queried from the resolved vol surface.

used_option_expiry.description: Option expiry date used by surface lookup (ISO date).

used_swap_tenor.description: Swap tenor descriptor used by lookup (e.g., date range).

used_strike.description: Strike used to query the volatility structure.

used_atm_forward.description:
ATM forward used when smile conventions need ATM anchoring. Absent when the
vol surface carries no ATM levels.

used_strike_kind.description: Strike convention used by the source swaption vol surface.

used_spread_from_atm.description:
Difference between used strike and cube ATM level. Absent unless the
surface uses spread-from-ATM strikes and an ATM level is available.

used_cube_node_atm.description: ATM level retrieved from cube node. Absent when no ATM level is available.

vol_kind.description: Resolved swaption volatility kind used by pricing.

used_model_param_mode.description: Effective model parameter mode used by the swaption engine.

used_hw_a.description: Effective Hull-White mean reversion "a" used by pricing. Absent when model is not HullWhiteLattice.

used_hw_sigma.description: Effective Hull-White sigma used by pricing. Absent when model is not HullWhiteLattice.

used_hw_rmse.description: Calibration RMSE for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_num_helpers.description: Number of calibration helpers for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_grid_rows.description: Calibration grid rows for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_grid_cols.description: Calibration grid columns for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_grid_points.description: Calibration grid points for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

diagnostics.description:
Per-surface diagnostics, one entry per unique SABR-kind vol surface
referenced by the priced swaptions. Populated only when the request
sets `include_diagnostics=true`. Empty/absent otherwise.
